instrument: Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire, original 39-item version
missing_policy: any missing item in a dimension makes that dimension sum/mean null; complete_required is a conservative product convention, not an author rule
source_note: Item texts and subscale key transcribed verbatim from the author-hosted PDF (Ruth A. Baer, University of Kentucky, https://www.ruthbaer.com/academics/). Scoring instruction (p.3): reverse all items marked R (1 to 5, 2 to 4, 4 to 2, 5 to 1; 3 unchanged), then sum each subscale. The PDF scoring table lists five subscales only and has no total row, so no total is defined. No norms, percentiles, or cutoffs are inferred.
